specs.Picture Quality Enhancement Technology: HDR10, DCI-P3 90%, Eye Care, AMD FreeSync Premium

features: 【🎮 QHD IPS Gaming Display】 Experience sharp, detailed gaming on the 27-inch QHD (2560 x 1440) IPS display. The wide 178° viewing angles and 1.07 billion colour support deliver consistent, immersive visuals for gaming, entertainment and everyday use.

【⚡ Up to 275Hz Ultra-Fast Refresh Rate】 Take your competitive gaming experience to the next level with an ultra-fast refresh rate of up to 275Hz overclock through DisplayPort. The monitor also supports Dynamic Refresh Rate (DRR) modes of 240Hz and 60Hz via DisplayPort for flexible performance.

【🚀 Up to 0.5ms GTG Response Time】 React faster during high-speed gameplay with an ultra-low response time of up to 0.5ms GTG (minimum). Fast pixel transitions help reduce motion blur and deliver clearer visuals during rapid movements, racing, FPS and action-packed games.

【🌈 DCI-P3 90% Wide Colour & HDR10】 Enjoy vibrant and lifelike visuals with 90% DCI-P3 wide colour gamut, HDR10 support and 8-bit + FRC colour technology. With support for up to 1.07 billion colours, the display delivers richer shades, smoother gradients and enhanced visual depth.

【🔗 FreeSync Premium & Versatile Connectivity】 AMD FreeSync Premium technology helps synchronize the monitor with compatible graphics hardware for smoother, tear-free gaming. Connect through 2 x HDMI 2.1 and 1 x DisplayPort 1.4, while built-in dual 2W speakers, audio-out, 100 x 100mm VESA mounting and -5° to 25° tilt add everyday convenience.
